scope: Audit actual current pipeline, repair response forecast numerical inconsistency and interrupted-run recovery; finite development experiment. Preserve prior failed outcomes and reserved tests.
architecture: LQR plus bounded residual, identical supervisor RK cost, 50ms freshness, .25 weight cap, .3s filter, .05 weight ramp, three-proposal recovery, .1% predicted cost margin. Same observer/plant and physical reward. Only causal response forecast uses 1ms RK4 instead of 10ms Euler.

training.initialization: Corresponding v11 final PPO, critic, optimizer and reward normalization. Fresh RNG/environment. In explore only, initial action-head weight and bias multiplied by .25 (temperature4), action-head Adam slots reset; other parameters/stats preserved. This is a predeclared exploration hypothesis, not a bug fix or an improvement claim. Same RNG/noise stream per pair across arms; later trajectories may differ.
training.optimizer: Unchanged lr1e-4/entropy.005/gamma.99/lambda.95/nsteps250/4env/batch200/5epochs. Submitted-request mask retained. Exactly six final50k endpoints; total300k additional steps. No extension or best-checkpoint/per-seed mixing.

development.comparison: All sources except legacy_prior use corrected forecast. prior=v11 unchanged weights, oldppo=v9 unchanged weights. legacy_prior is paired v11 weights plus v11 forecast for numerical A/B. Planner uses corrected causal forecast, frozen nominal model and same gate. Both fixed corrections and LQR kept.

acceptance: Primary20% lower mean episode tracking RMSE vs LQR, fixed +/-0.04, student, oldppo, prior and causal planner; survival all; positive paired gain in each seed group vs each comparator; nominal <=1.02LQR; heading/rate RMS <=1.05LQR. Report both arms, no final winner from this audit. Published robust vehicle reproduction absent; no all-literature or deployment claim.
resume: After every10k steps: immutable atomic snapshot of PPO/Adam, full vecenv/queue/observer/scenario state, reward normalizer including returns, counters and Python/NumPy/Torch RNG. Check signatures/checksums before restore. In-flight work after last complete snapshot is replayed. Partial episodes never become completed evidence; completed episode files individually hashed and verified on resume. --publish commits/pushes each checkpoint and each completed evaluation pair; no force push.
stop: After both arms and full matched development/replay; failed targets remain failed. Reserved/native/laptop/physical evidence and winner timing are separate follow-up gates. No further training automatically.
